title: Workspace CLI to authenticated tool gateway

requirements.initial: A Workspace CLI request names a mapped tool.
requirements.action: Send invalid or unknown flags and scoped invocations.
requirements.expected: The gateway rejects invalid input and does not escape the Workspace export scope.

evidence.assertion: invoke 400s LOUDLY on an unknown flag, naming the key
evidence.scope: Hono gateway with registered test tools.

evidence.assertion: the workspace export cannot reach a data tool (marketSearchForResearch)
evidence.scope: Gateway scope boundary, not a real CLI subprocess.

requirements.gap: Socket/HTTP parity and cancellation/error propagation across a real CLI need additional mapped evidence.

requirements.initial: A packaged Workspace has launcher-composed identity and environment.
requirements.action: Invoke shipped CLI manifests and tools through preload/PTY.
requirements.expected: The real shims and tool socket perform an observable operation.

evidence.assertion: real CLI manifest and side-effect acceptance
evidence.scope: Built package with loopback mock provider; not arbitrary third-party runtime acceptance.

requirements.gap: Disconnect during an in-flight tool call and retry ownership remain unmapped.
